author: Learn Linux TV
description:
In this tutorial, you'll learn how to use Warehouse — a powerful graphical tool for managing Flatpak applications on Linux. Warehouse gives you full control over your Flatpak apps, including the ability to manage user data, create snapshots, and restore previous states — all from a clean, easy-to-use interface.

Whether you're new to Flatpak or a seasoned Linux user looking for a better way to manage your apps, this video covers everything you need to get started with Warehouse on any Linux distribution that supports Flatpak and Flathub.
